'''Levsh oil''' was a type of cooking [[Oil/Legends|oil]]. [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] at the [[Krevk Settlement]] on [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]] used the oil to cook [[Reeho (bird)|reeho]].<ref name="BG">{{JournalCite|14|The Breath of Gelgelar}}</ref>
